_note: The club on each player's post is whatever was on arvandsport.com when tools/extract.mjs last ran, and several are years out of date. This file corrects the current club without touching content/players.json, so re-running the extractor cannot silently revert a correction, and every entry carries the source it was taken from. Remove an entry once the live site itself is updated. The agency's own records outrank anything here — overwrite freely.

<player-slug>.since: YYYY-MM the move completed, as published
<player-slug>.source: URL the club was read from
<player-slug>.checked: YYYY-MM-DD this entry was last verified
<player-slug>.confidence: high | medium — medium means one source, or sources that disagree
<player-slug>.previous: the club this move was from, when it is worth naming on the site

mehdi-taremi.note: Porto to Inter on a free in 2024, Inter to Olympiacos in August 2025, Olympiacos to Al Wasl. The agency supplied the current and previous club directly on 30 Aug 2026, which outranks the published sources this file otherwise cites; no month was given for the move, so `since` is empty. The agency wrote Olympiakos and the rest of this file says Olympiacos, which is the spelling ESPN uses -- kept as Olympiacos so the site says one thing.
